findings.title: Bound the stream read before parsing
findings.cause: for line in reader reads/allocates an unlimited newline-delimited string; parse_line length check only runs after that read completes. Whitespace-only lines bypass parse_line entirely.
findings.impact: A malformed or buggy peer on the trusted SSH stream can retain/allocate arbitrarily large input and delay error/EOF cleanup. This is robustness inside the existing trusted channel, not an independent authorization bypass; normal SshDisplayClient commands are small.
findings.recommendation: Use reader.readline(8193) in a loop; reject length >8192 before whitespace handling, break on EOF, then retain current parse/dispatch/finally-close behavior. Existing SSH reply reader already uses this pattern.
